identityAccess.title: Identity & access
identityAccess.description: Keycloak is the runtime authority for accounts, credentials, and authorization.
identityAccess.electronOnly: Identity management is available only in the Electron desktop app.
identityAccess.deviceRequest: Node {node} requests to sign in as you
identityAccess.signInDisabled: Bind and connect Keycloak before signing in
identityAccess.bindingManagedAtCenter: Center administrators configure the binding at the center's original local session; it is read only here.
identityAccess.unboundNextStep: Install managed Keycloak or connect an external Keycloak below.
identityAccess.loginLoadError: The Keycloak sign-in page could not be loaded ({error}). Retry in the page below, or cancel.
identityAccess.openConsole: Open the admin console in your browser
identityAccess.externalDescription: Use the harness-center service account. Its secret is write only; the realm and credentials are checked before saving.
identityAccess.bootstrapDescription: This realm has no Harness administrator. This entry point closes permanently after creation.
settings.title: Settings
accessControl.tagline: See each member’s roles by scope; grant or revoke access here.
accessControl.service.title: Authorization service · Keycloak
accessControl.lifetime.title: Sign-in session lifetime
accessControl.lifetime.label: Sign in again after being idle for
accessControl.lifetime.range: Allowed: {minimum}–{maximum} minutes; active sessions renew automatically.
accessControl.groups.baseRule: A Base group is generated from each action's declared policy tier and cannot be edited: {own} actions at its own tier, inherits {inherits}, {effective} effective actions in total.
accessControl.groups.baseFooter: Base groups are read-only; create a custom group that inherits one to change the mix.
accessControl.groups.inheritedAction: Comes from an inherited group; stop inheriting that group to remove it
accessControl.groups.conflict: Another administrator changed this group, so your change was not written (you read version {expected}, it is now {current}). Load the latest version and edit again.
accessControl.effective.title: Effective permissions: {personId} on {scope}
accessControl.effective.deniedNoGrant: This person holds no grant on this scope, so all {count} actions are denied.
accessControl.effective.deniedNotInclude: These {count} actions are denied: no policy group this person holds on this scope includes them.
accessControl.receipts.title: Audit receipts
accessControl.receipts.footer: Audit only, never evaluated; newest first
accessControl.receipts.unsettledFooter: {count} operations have no settled receipt: reconciling checks what Keycloak shows and never repeats the write
accessControl.error.authenticationRequir: Sign in with Keycloak to administer access control.
accessControl.error.authorizationDenied: This account is not an access administrator (the access-admin role is missing), so it cannot view or change access control.
accessControl.error.baseReadOnly: Base groups are generated and cannot be changed or deleted.
accessControl.error.groupExists: A policy group with this ID already exists; choose another.
accessControl.error.groupUnknown: This policy group no longer exists; another administrator may have deleted it.
accessControl.error.groupInUse: This group is still inherited by another group or granted to someone; remove those first.
accessControl.error.versionConflict: Another administrator changed this first, so your change was not written; refresh and try again.
accessControl.error.personUnknown: Keycloak has no account for this person.
accessControl.error.resourceInvalid: The scope is not valid: a repository ID starts with a lowercase letter and an object reference looks like task/task_….
accessControl.error.receiptUnsettled: This operation reached Keycloak without a settled receipt; reconcile it under Audit receipts instead of repeating it.
accessControl.error.sessionLifetimeInval: The session lifetime is outside the allowed range.
accessControl.error.notConfigured: No authorization service is bound yet; bind one under Authorization service first.
accessControl.error.serviceUnavailable: Keycloak cannot be reached, so access control cannot be viewed or changed right now.
accessControl.error.daemonUnavailable: The local daemon cannot be reached.
accessControl.effective.emptyHint: Choose a person and a scope and press Show effective permissions, or pick a grant on the right: this lists what that person can do on the scope, which group each action comes from, and what is denied.
accessControl.teams.title: Work teams
accessControl.teams.rule: Work teams receive task assignments together. Joining a team does not grant access; grant roles under Members & access.
accessControl.teams.name: Team name
accessControl.teams.choose: Select a team to see its members, or open the form with New work team.
taskAssignment.title: Task assignment
taskAssignment.rule: Reassign only after releasing the active lease. Team membership does not grant permission to start.
taskAssignment.holderNote: Assignment expiry and the lease are independent: an expired qualification only reopens assignment, it does not interrupt a held lease.
taskAssignment.defaultExpiry: Leave expiry empty to use the repository default. Changing the default does not change existing assignments.
collaboration.title: Collaboration
collaboration.empty: No fleet nodes for this repository yet.
collaboration.centerNotice: This machine is the fleet center: leases executed over the local channel count toward the Center node; connected edges appear alongside it.
collaboration.fleetNote: Fleet topology: nodes, replica channels and what is happening; served by a daemon read-only query
collaboration.readFailed: The fleet overview could not be read: {error}
collaboration.topologyNote: Click a node to see what it is doing and its internal state
collaboration.eventsNote: canonical event window, attributed by each task's current lease; click an event to open its node
collaboration.eventsEmpty: No events for this node in the window.
collaboration.noLeases: No task leases held right now.
collaboration.reason.onlineNotExposed: The center does not expose per-node TLS session facts in this read; online state arrives once session facts join it.
collaboration.reason.buildNotInReplicaSt: Replica status rows carry no build field; this arrives once edges report their build.
collaboration.reason.syncInternalsNotExp: Watch/pull internals live on the edge node; this arrives once edge-side read-only queries are exposed.
collaboration.reason.noSyncFailureRecord: The lifecycle read holds no replica sync failure record for this node yet.
collaboration.reason.registryNotQueried: No owner registration was found for this node.
collaboration.reason.noReplicaRow: This node has never synced to this center, or its lease travels another channel.
collaboration.reason.authorizationDenied: Your identity is not authorized to view these leases.
collaboration.reason.insufficientScope: Your identity's scope does not cover viewing these leases.
collaboration.note.eventsAttribution: Events are attributed to the node currently holding each task's lease; older events may predate the current holder.
collaboration.note.edgeOnline: Online state needs the center's TLS session facts, which this read does not expose yet.
collaboration.note.syncInternals: Edge sync internals (watch/pull/backoff and sync failures) need edge-side read-only queries, not exposed by this read yet.
collaboration.warning.ownerRegistryUnava: The node owner registry could not be queried; owner shows as not provided on affected nodes.
collaboration.readError.authorizationDen: Your identity is not authorized to view the fleet topology (the grant was revoked or never given).
collaboration.readError.insufficientScop: Your identity's scope does not cover viewing the fleet topology.
collaboration.readError.authenticationRe: Sign in before viewing the fleet topology.
accessControl.role.viewer.summary: Read repository content; cannot create or change records.
accessControl.role.contributor.summary: Read and contribute tasks, decisions and facts; cannot assign or close tasks, or perform maintainer reviews.
accessControl.role.maintainer.summary: Includes contribution, task assignment and closure, and decision review; excludes administrator operations.
accessControl.role.admin.summary: Includes maintenance and declared administrator actions within the granted scope. Access administration eligibility is determined separately by the service.
accessControl.members.title: Members & access
accessControl.members.noGrant: No direct grants in this view
accessControl.members.confirmHint: Check the member, role and scope. Changes are written only after confirmation.
accessControl.members.workPending: Work access is not available yet. Object grants cover that object only, not its child tasks.
accessControl.service.danger: Changing the authorization service affects sign-in and access for every account. Use only when maintaining the center service.
devices.title: My devices
devices.boundary: Changing a password or signing out in the Keycloak console does not reliably disconnect devices. Remove a device or sign out all devices here to revoke their access.
devices.idle: Each device needs your approval once. Devices unused for more than 90 days need approval again. Resuming a paused device requires a new sign-in.
devices.empty: No devices registered to your account. Register a device, then approve its sign-in.
devices.name: Device name
devices.confirmation: Further requests will use the new device state. Pausing or removing revokes this device’s sessions; resuming requires approval again. A running device may still be stopping. Removed device IDs cannot be reused.
